days.title: National Women Physicians Day
days.summary: Marks Dr. Elizabeth Blackwell's birthday, honouring women doctors.

days.title: Doctors' Day (USA / International)
days.summary: Commemorates the first surgical use of ether anaesthesia, in 1842.

days.title: International Day of the Midwife
days.summary: Recognises midwives' role in maternal and newborn care.

days.title: International Nurses Day
days.summary: Marks Florence Nightingale's birth anniversary.

days.title: World Family Doctor Day
days.summary: Declared by WONCA to celebrate family physicians and GPs.

days.title: National Doctors' Day (India)
days.summary: Honours Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy, on the anniversary of his birth and death.

days.title: World Physiotherapy Day
days.summary: Recognises physiotherapists in rehabilitation and mobility.

days.title: World Pharmacists Day
days.summary: Highlights pharmacists' contributions to medication safety.

days.title: World Anaesthesia Day
days.summary: Marks the 1846 public demonstration of surgical ether anaesthesia.

days.title: World Radiography Day
days.summary: Marks Wilhelm Röntgen's 1895 discovery of X-rays.

days.title: National Vaccination Day (India)
days.summary: Marks the first Pulse Polio oral vaccine dose in India, in 1995.

days.title: World Tuberculosis Day
days.summary: Global TB awareness and elimination efforts.

days.title: World Health Day
days.summary: Marks the founding of the World Health Organization (WHO).

days.title: National Safe Motherhood Day (India)
days.summary: Maternal healthcare awareness, on Kasturba Gandhi's birth anniversary.

days.title: World Patient Safety Day
days.summary: WHO campaign to reduce preventable harm in clinical care.

days.title: World Heart Day
days.summary: Cardiovascular disease prevention and awareness.

days.title: National Voluntary Blood Donation Day (India)
days.summary: Promotes safe, voluntary blood donation across India.

days.title: World Mental Health Day
days.summary: Global mental health advocacy and destigmatisation.

days.title: World Stroke Day
days.summary: Stroke prevention, early recognition and acute care.

days.title: National Cancer Awareness Day (India)
days.summary: Cancer screening and early detection, on Marie Curie's birthday.

days.title: World Diabetes Day
days.summary: Marks Sir Frederick Banting's birthday (insulin co-discoverer).

days.title: National Epilepsy Day (India)
days.summary: Public awareness on epilepsy diagnosis and management.
